section.title: Scheduled tasks
section.subtitle: Six kinds of time selectors plus a time zone; when due, the task is delivered back to the session that created it
field.howItWorks.label: How this works
field.howItWorks.text: When a task comes due, its description is delivered to the model as one message and a full turn runs. The delivered text says this is a timer, not a user instruction, and grants no authority; anything that needs authority still goes through the approval card.
field.enabled.label: Enable scheduled tasks
field.enabled.help: While off nothing is delivered when due (task definitions and the run log are kept). The plugin's own switch is on the Plugins page.
field.timeZone.label: Default time zone
field.timeZone.help: An IANA zone name. The wall-clock times of daily / weekly / cron are all resolved against it; times inside a DST gap are skipped.
field.maxRunSeconds.label: Longest single run (seconds)
field.maxRunSeconds.help: How long to wait for the turn to end after delivery. A timeout only changes how the failure count is recorded; it never interrupts a running turn.
field.historyLimit.label: History entries kept
field.historyLimit.help: How many entries the run log (runs.jsonl) and each task's delivery history keep; delivery history is also capped at 30 days.
field.tasks.label: Tasks ({count})
field.tasks.empty: No scheduled tasks yet. Create one with /schedule add every:30m stand up and stretch.
field.check.label: Run a check now
field.check.help: Runs the due check once right away (fills dangling slots, catches up on missed schedules) and reports the result to the session.
field.state.label: State
field.dataDir.label: Data directory
field.dataDir.help: tasks.json holds the task definitions, runs.jsonl the run log, and .lock the cross-process scheduler lock.
field.limits.label: What it cannot do
save.unknownTimeZone: Time zone “{zone}” is not recognized; use an IANA name such as Asia/Shanghai
save.notIntegerMaxRun: The longest single run must be a whole number of seconds.
save.rangeMaxRun: The longest single run must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
save.notIntegerHistory: The number of history entries must be a whole number.
save.rangeHistory: The number of history entries must be between {min} and {max}.
